name: feature-encoding-studio
description: Silent cinematic educational videos on Feature Encoding (Label, One-Hot, Ordinal) built with Remotion.

scripts.render:label: remotion render src/index.ts LabelEncoding out/01-label-encoding.mp4 --codec=h264 --muted
scripts.render:all: npm run render:label && npm run render:onehot && npm run render:ordinal && npm run render:comparison
scripts.still:diagrams: remotion still src/index.ts DiagramNumberLine out/diagram-1-number-line.png --frame=240 && remotion still src/index.ts DiagramOneHot out/diagram-2-one-hot.png --frame=240 && remotion still src/index.ts DiagramStaircase out/diagram-3-staircase.png --frame=240
